purpose: Reads and builds the links on a Function, Solution, Value or Resource card as plain functions: which record a link points at, the tag drawn for it, the loop checks on the Part of chain, and the Solution of relations read back.
namedChanges: the imports of `./config` (`vaultOriginOf`), `./planFind` (`pageAttributeIds`) and `./picture` (`vaultIdOfEntity`) are removed: they were used only by `tagUsedInVault`, which is cut (lines 214-228 with its doc comment). `typeFacetKey` of `./workingSetFacets` was used only by `isTypeName`;
`MASTER_TAG_SLUGS` of `./entityDisplayName` (line 28) is a non-exported `const MASTER_TAG_SLUGS = ["unitTag", "tag"] as const;` in the file, with the same value;
`isTypeName` (lines 28-31) is deleted and imported from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-type-key`, then re-exported (`export { isTypeName };`), so the export list is the source's;

`childrenPointingAt(record, typed)` (line 269) is `childrenPointingAt(record, typed, SKIP_SLUGS)`. The app's version skips eleven identity names inside; the `entity-ref` unit takes them as an argument. `const SKIP_SLUGS = new Set([...])` is copied from `src/lib/base/entityRefFacts.ts` lines 21-33 (same eleven names) as a non-exported constant.

library.title: Plan card links model (Part of, Solution of)
library.note: Pure link reading and loop checks; the link lines on screen are plan-tag-links.
